distinction_from_closed_static_lane.old_question: Do fixed breeding-site attributes predict demographic response across Antarctic Pygoscelis?
distinction_from_closed_static_lane.new_question: Does temporal change in accessible breeding opportunity predict temporal redistribution of breeding effort?
distinction_from_closed_static_lane.rule: The dynamic lane cannot be described as a rescue or sensitivity analysis of the closed static-place results.

primary_hypothesis.statement: Within a conspecific regional temporal context, breeding sites that gain more accessible ice-free breeding opportunity will show more positive relative demographic change.
primary_hypothesis.forbidden_substitute: Do not replace relative reallocation with a post-hoc raw site abundance association if the regional adjustment is unsupported.

antarctic_specific_modifier.statement: The demographic value of newly available terrestrial breeding opportunity depends on marine accessibility during breeding.
antarctic_specific_modifier.no_fishing_rule: One marine-access metric or a predeclared compact index must be frozen before demographic outcomes are joined; do not search a broad environmental covariate set.

primary_ecological_unit.unit: breeding-site node within a species x regional temporal network
primary_ecological_unit.repeated_species_at_same_site: not independent physical habitat replicates; model or resampling must account for shared site identity
primary_ecological_unit.region_boundary: APBP/forcing-support grouping is a monitoring/temporal adjustment unit, not a claimed closed population

terrestrial_exposure.conceptual_definition: change in accessible ice-free breeding opportunity inside the frozen site-centered spatial support
terrestrial_exposure.primary_scale: 2 km site-centered support inherited from the outcome-blind breeding-options atlas unless pixel QA shows that this support cannot be measured consistently
terrestrial_exposure.baseline_area_role: nuisance/context term if required by the later frozen model, not a renewed static-place hypothesis
terrestrial_exposure.metric_selection_rule: Pixel/classification and topographic-access rules are frozen using remote-sensing QA, published biological criteria and external controls only; penguin count outcomes cannot choose the metric.

response_concept.primary: site demographic change relative to the shared conspecific regional temporal state
response_concept.preferred_parameterization: site habitat-change rate x centered time interaction after site intercepts and support-selected species/regional time effects
response_concept.secondary: direct change in site share within fixed-roster regional networks with sufficient complete seasons
not_primary: raw site trend without regional temporal adjustment
binary persistence selected after seeing habitat change
within-site subcolony contraction, because MAPPPD site totals do not measure subcolony footprints

external_validation.beaufort_positive_control: The habitat pipeline must recover positive terrestrial-opportunity change at Beaufort Island over the closest supported historical-to-2010 comparison before multi-site habitat-change values are used.
external_validation.demographic_independence: Published Beaufort demographic response is not used for classifier tuning and is not counted as a new mina demographic test.

continuation_gate_without_demographic_ma.regional_replication: at least two regional groups with >=5 eligible physical sites
continuation_gate_without_demographic_ma.failure_action: stop dynamic terrestrial lane without lowering thresholds; move to mobile-substrate emperor lane

outcomes_that_would_be_interesting.tracking: Positive relative reallocation toward sites gaining terrestrial opportunity.
outcomes_that_would_be_interesting.land_sea_decoupling: Terrestrial opportunity expands at many sites without corresponding relative demographic gain; a predeclared marine-access modifier explains part of the mismatch.
outcomes_that_would_be_interesting.species_contingency: Species-specific opportunity-tracking coefficients differ in sign or magnitude.
outcomes_that_would_be_interesting.dynamic_null: Measured change in accessible breeding opportunity does not explain relative reallocation even after adequate remote-sensing support.

claim_boundaries: Do not infer individual dispersal from site redistribution.
Do not call APBP regions closed demographic populations.
Do not interpret exposed substrate as occupied nesting habitat.
Do not claim full land-sea coupling from a land-only result.
Do not alter Paper 1 endpoints or count the dynamic test as additional Paper 1 confirmation.
